chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from more than one (narrator), from Abu Abdullah (AS), who said:
It was said to him (AS) regarding the Punishment: when it befalls upon a people, does it strike the Momineen (believers)? He (AS) said: 'Yes, but they are saved after it.'

key_terms.الْعَذَابِ: the Punishment — divine chastisement sent upon a people as a consequence of their wrongdoing
key_terms.الْمُؤْمِنِينَ: the Momineen — the true believers who are present among the afflicted people
key_terms.بَعْدَهُ: after it — indicating the temporal sequence: tribulation first, then salvation
key_terms.قَوْمٍ: a group or people — the collective upon whom the punishment descends
key_terms.يَخْلُصُونَ: they are saved/delivered — the believers' ultimate rescue and deliverance following the ordeal
key_terms.يُصِيبُ: strikes/afflicts — the act of the punishment reaching and affecting someone

ai.seo_question: According to Imam al-Sadiq (AS), do believers suffer when divine punishment descends upon a sinful people?
ai.summary: This hadith from Imam Abu Abdullah al-Sadiq (AS) addresses whether divine punishment sent upon a people also strikes the believers present among them. The Imam (AS) affirms that believers are indeed struck by such collective punishment, but crucially distinguishes their fate: they are ultimately delivered and saved after it, unlike those upon whom the punishment is truly deserved. This teaching illuminates the Shia theological understanding that worldly tribulation is not necessarily a sign of divine wrath against the believer, and that divine protection (wilayah) ensures their ultimate salvation.

en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from someone else, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘It was said to himasws, ‘With regards to the Punishment when it befalls upon a group, would the Momineen be hit?’ Heasws said: ‘Yes, but they would be Saved after it’.
en.sarwar: 3. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘Umayr from more than one narrator from abu ‘Abd Allah who has said the following: “
It was asked, ‘In the case of punishment that descends upon a people, does it affect the believers also?’ The Imam said, ‘Yes, but they find salvation in the hereafter.’”
